harvested_sources.title: Augment Code Raises $227M Series C at $2B+ Valuation — Ship or Skip
harvested_sources.summary:
Augment Code announced a $227 million Series C led by Index Ventures, valuing the company above $2 billion. The round funds two core bets: (1) agentic code review that autonomously surfaces issues and refactors during PR workflows, and (2) large-scale codebase understanding to index and reason across millions of lines of code, addressing enterprise-scale needs beyond single-developer productivity. The company markets itself against GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, and Tabnine by emphasizing organizational-scale context rather than file-level context.

Key takeaways:
- Financing: $227M Series C; valuation >$2B; investor: Index Ventures.
- Focus areas: agentic code review; extensive codebase indexing/understanding.
- Strategy: target enterprise teams with complex legacy systems and shared codebases.
- Market positioning: differentiates via architecture built for organizational scale and context across large codebases.
- Outlook: aims to validate its bets on enterprise adoption and whether its context-window & indexing approach can outperform competitors at scale. Potential implications for roles and workflows if agentic reviews prove effective.

Note: No announcements found in provided extras about 2025–2026 product launches, hiring, or specific press releases beyond the Series C news.

harvested_sources.title: Augment Code Launches Easy MCP: One-Click Integration With
harvested_sources.summary:
Summary:
Augment Code announces Easy MCP, a one-click integration capability enabling developers to connect CircleCI, MongoDB, Redis, Sentry, and Stripe to its AI coding assistant via the VS Code extension. Leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Easy MCP streams live runtime context (build logs, databases, errors, payment events) to augment code generation and reasoning without complex setup. Enhancements include deeper native integrations for Stripe and Sentry. Integrations are configured by API tokens or OAuth, bypassing typical configuration steps. The release positions Augment Code as a leader for AI-assisted coding on large codebases, with ongoing ecosystem partnerships and emphasis on real-time context. Founding and funding details: established 2022, emerged from stealth in 2024, backed by Sutter Hill Ventures, Index Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Innovation Endeavors, and Meritech Capital. Product launch activity cited for 2025; no specific funding rounds or hiring/expansion details provided in the release. For more information, visit augmentcode.com.

harvested_sources.title: Augment Code launches Cosmos to bring agentic AI software development to teams - SiliconANGLE
harvested_sources.summary:
Summary:
- Augment Code Computing Inc. announced Cosmos, a software delivery lifecycle platform designed for engineering teams to collaborate with agentic AI. Cosmos goes beyond individual coding assistants by enabling cross-team planning, development, and deployment with shared knowledge.
- Cosmos provides both developer-level agents and organization-wide workflows. It emphasizes human oversight in prioritization, intent validation, and high-risk decisions, while agents handle execution.
- A key feature is Cosmos’ cross-team adviser, which helps users select the right expert and environment and routes tasks to the appropriate agent automatically, reducing the need to know specific agents.
- The platform aims to democratize access to knowledge and data across teams, mitigating bureaucracy and knowledge silos.

Notes:
- The article is a product launch update (June 5, 2026) and frames Cosmos as a shift from standalone AI coding assistants to an integrated, team-wide AI software delivery lifecycle solution.
